title: tephrosia × smallii
intro: Tephrosia × smallii, commonly known as Small's tephrosia, is a hybrid plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The health benefits of Small's tephrosia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
